name: רְפָיָה
summary: Rephaiah joins the healing root with the short divine name. The name occurs in the line of David, among the sons of Ishi, among the sons of Tola, in Saul’s family, and for the son of Hur who helped repair Jerusalem’s wall.
note: The genealogy calls Binea’s son Raphah in 1 Chronicles 8:37 and Rephaiah in the parallel at 9:43.
